name: astrodynamics-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server giving any LLM client authoritative astrodynamics tools — TLE/SGP4, Lambert, ground-station access, time/frame conversions, porkchop, B-plane.
long_description: astrodynamics-mcp exposes authoritative astrodynamics tools to any MCP-capable LLM client over stdio. The base install ships nine tools: tle_lookup (CelesTrak, or Space-Track with credentials), sgp4_propagate, lambert_solve, access_windows, time_convert, frame_transform, porkchop, bplane_target, and satellite_metadata (ESA DISCOSweb). With the optional [gmat] extra and a local NASA GMAT install, five more register for driving real GMAT missions: gmat_run_mission, gmat_sweep, gmat_execute_script, gmat_validate_script, and gmat_read_run_artefact. Every result carries explicit units and frame strings; failures surface as typed AstroMCPError envelopes. Tools call vetted upstream libraries (sgp4, lamberthub, skyfield, astropy) and no-auth data sources (CelesTrak, JPL Horizons, IERS); credentialed sources (Space-Track, ESA DISCOSweb) are used only when you configure them.
